actions.name: Send Out
actions.description:
Using the method of their choosing, the user brings the targeted creature from their Team into combat (at the start of the combat, this may be done as a Free Action).

In @Trait[conventional] settings creatures are stored and released from @Trait[ball]s. Creatures can be sent out in the following ways:

  • Released from the Ball within 6m of the user while the Ball is on the user.
  • Released from the Ball within 3m of a space the Ball is Flung at (this Fling is freely done as part of this Action)
